description: track() never records real USD. The spec's north star (spec line 12-14) and INV-7 require record-earn to count the real inflow on merge. But track() on a MERGED PR only increments a counter and emits a PROSE string: `emit "track: $tracked PR(s) monitored, $merged merged. (on merge → record-earn when payout lands)"`. record-earn.mjs is NEVER invoked. Compare the correct reference pattern in skills/earn/gig/archive/run.sh:124-137 (do_settle resolves $HOME/anicca/skills/self/founder-loop/record-earn.mjs and runs `node "$re" --task settle`, parsing 'VERIFIED +N USDC'). record-earn.mjs DOES exist on disk at skills/self/founder-loop/record-earn.mjs — bounty simply does not call it. CONSEQUENCE: even if a PR somehow merged and a payout landed, the loop would record $0. There is no code path in the bounty slot that records a real dollar.

evidence.snippet: case "$st" in MERGED*) merged=$((merged+1));; esac ... emit "track: $tracked PR(s) monitored, $merged merged. (on merge → record-earn when payout lands)"
